name: Hulen Pointe
summary: Hulen Pointe is a neighborhood shopping center in southwest Fort Worth, offering convenient access to everyday services including Great Clips and other local retailers. With strong community ratings and flexible hours, it serves as a practical destination for residents seeking quick, accessible shopping and personal care services.
demographics: Hulen Pointe serves the southwest Fort Worth market, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and professionals from the surrounding residential neighborhoods. The trade area includes a mix of established homeowners and young families, with household incomes typically ranging from $60,000 to $100,000 annually. Shoppers in this area prioritize convenience and value, seeking quick-service options for everyday needs like haircuts, dining, and personal services. The center benefits from strong drive-by traffic along Oakmont Boulevard, drawing customers who prefer accessible, no-hassle shopping experiences close to home.
description: Hulen Pointe is a convenient neighborhood shopping center located at 6207 Oakmont Boulevard in the thriving southwest Fort Worth area. This well-positioned retail destination serves the local community with a practical mix of service-oriented tenants, anchored by Great Clips, one of America's most recognized hair salon brands. The center benefits from excellent visibility and accessibility along Oakmont Boulevard, making it a go-to stop for residents seeking everyday conveniences. With operating hours from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM, Hulen Pointe caters to busy professionals and families who need flexible scheduling for their personal care and shopping needs. The center maintains a strong reputation in the community, reflected in its 4.2-star rating from over 1,700 customer reviews, demonstrating consistent service quality and customer satisfaction.
